svg.text: bias: Sooch wide-swing cascode (vbp, vbnc, vbpc from vbn)
comp45 + R100: M1/M2 4x wider, NMOS/PMOS sources and PMOS cascodes 4x wider and L=4u, RZ 1u/100u (R100), CC 45u x 23u (comp45). The notes below are the revision-B design values.
Folded cascode: left branch M14/M15/M13/M3 (mirror side, node mir), right branch M11/M12/M16/M4 (node out1).
Design currents (generator, vbn from an 8u/1u diode at 10 uA equivalent): tail 80 uA, PMOS sources 60 uA, NMOS sources 100 uA,
stage 2 120 uA class A; Cc 0.8 pF, Rz 1.7 kOhm. inn on M1 (mirror side), inp on M2: out rises when inp rises.
Bodies: wire to source where equal; b:<net> tag where the body is a rail but not the source.
